description: Na₂LiSrVP₂O₉ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.71 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.79 Å. Li is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted LiO₅ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent LiO₅ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.11 Å. Sr is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.99 Å. V is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-2.55 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share edges with two equivalent LiO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.58 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one LiO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.57 Å. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Sr, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Sr, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one V, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Li, one V, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sr, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Sr, one V, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Sr, one V, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two Na, two equivalent Li, one V, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Sr, and one V atom.
